data/MemoryDao.kt#undigestedLines:
SELECT l.* FROM transcript_lines l JOIN segments s ON s.id = l.segmentId
           WHERE l.digestedAt IS NULL AND s.status = 'Done' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM topic_spans ts JOIN topics t ON t.id = ts.topicId
    WHERE t.status != 'Cancelled' AND l.startAt >= ts.startAt AND l.startAt < COALESCE(ts.endAt, t.plannedEndAt,
        (SELECT MIN(initial_span.startAt) + 14400000 FROM topic_spans initial_span WHERE initial_span.topicId = t.id))) AND l.voiceInputPendingUntil IS NULL AND (s.importRecordId IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM import_records r WHERE r.id = s.importRecordId AND r.ingestComplete = 1 AND r.speakersReady = 1)) ORDER BY l.startAt, l.id
data/MemoryDao.kt#undigestedCount:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transcript_lines l JOIN segments s ON s.id = l.segmentId
           WHERE l.digestedAt IS NULL AND s.status = 'Done' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM topic_spans ts JOIN topics t ON t.id = ts.topicId
    WHERE t.status != 'Cancelled' AND l.startAt >= ts.startAt AND l.startAt < COALESCE(ts.endAt, t.plannedEndAt,
        (SELECT MIN(initial_span.startAt) + 14400000 FROM topic_spans initial_span WHERE initial_span.topicId = t.id))) AND l.voiceInputPendingUntil IS NULL AND (s.importRecordId IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM import_records r WHERE r.id = s.importRecordId AND r.ingestComplete = 1 AND r.speakersReady = 1)) ORDER BY l.startAt, l.id
data/MemoryDao.kt#observeUndigestedCount:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transcript_lines l JOIN segments s ON s.id = l.segmentId WHERE l.digestedAt IS NULL AND s.status = 'Done' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM topic_spans ts JOIN topics t ON t.id = ts.topicId
    WHERE t.status != 'Cancelled' AND l.startAt >= ts.startAt AND l.startAt < COALESCE(ts.endAt, t.plannedEndAt,
        (SELECT MIN(initial_span.startAt) + 14400000 FROM topic_spans initial_span WHERE initial_span.topicId = t.id)))
data/MemoryDao.kt#diaryLines:
SELECT l.* FROM transcript_lines l JOIN segments s ON s.id = l.segmentId
        LEFT JOIN memory_events e ON e.id = l.eventId
        WHERE s.status = 'Done' AND l.startAt >= :start AND l.startAt < :end
        AND (e.id IS NULL OR e.deleted = 0) ORDER BY l.startAt, l.id
data/MemoryDao.kt#latestDiaryAt:
SELECT MAX(at) FROM (
        SELECT startAt AS at FROM memory_events WHERE deleted = 0 AND (scene != '媒体' OR starred = 1)
        UNION ALL SELECT l.startAt AS at FROM transcript_lines l JOIN segments s ON s.id = l.segmentId
        LEFT JOIN memory_events e ON e.id = l.eventId WHERE :includeLines AND s.status = 'Done' AND l.text != '' AND (e.id IS NULL OR e.deleted = 0)
    )
data/TranscribeDao.kt#observeQueueCounts:
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Pending' THEN 1 END) AS pending,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Failed' THEN 1 END) AS failed,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Running' THEN 1 END) > 0 AS running FROM segments
data/TranscribeDao.kt#recentDone: SELECT * FROM segments WHERE status = 'Done' AND startAt >= :since
data/TranscribeDao.kt#expired: SELECT * FROM segments WHERE status IN ('Done', 'Empty', 'SkippedPlayback', 'SkippedEnv', 'Abandoned', 'Quiet') AND completedAt <= :before
data/VoiceInputDao.kt#observed: SELECT * FROM transcript_lines WHERE voiceInputJson IS NOT NULL ORDER BY startAt DESC, id DESC
data/VoiceprintDao.kt#observePersonLines: SELECT * FROM transcript_lines WHERE speakerPersonId = :id AND voiceInputJson IS NULL ORDER BY startAt DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100
data/VoiceprintDao.kt#invalidate: UPDATE segments SET voiceprintProcessedAt = NULL WHERE sourceId != 'voice-input' AND status = 'Done'
data/VoiceprintDao.kt#doneSegments: SELECT * FROM segments WHERE sourceId != 'voice-input' AND status = 'Done'
push/PushRecords.kt#lines: SELECT l.* FROM transcript_lines l JOIN segments s ON s.id = l.segmentId WHERE s.status = 'Done' AND l.startAt >= :start ORDER BY l.startAt, l.id
skills/SkillDao.kt#lines: SELECT l.* FROM transcript_lines l JOIN segments s ON s.id = l.segmentId LEFT JOIN memory_events e ON e.id = l.eventId WHERE s.status = 'Done' AND l.startAt >= :start AND l.startAt < :end AND (e.id IS NULL OR e.deleted = 0) ORDER BY l.startAt, l.id
topic/TopicData.kt#observeLateTranscript:
SELECT t.id FROM topics t WHERE t.status = 'Done' AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM topic_spans ts JOIN transcript_lines l ON l.startAt >= ts.startAt AND l.startAt < ts.endAt
        JOIN segments s ON s.id = l.segmentId WHERE ts.topicId = t.id AND s.status = 'Done'
        AND l.voiceInputPendingUntil IS NULL AND (l.eventId IS NOT t.eventId OR l.digestedAt IS NULL)) ORDER BY t.id
topic/TopicData.kt#digestedUntil: SELECT MAX(endAt) FROM transcript_lines WHERE digestedAt IS NOT NULL AND startAt < :end AND endAt > :start
topic/TopicData.kt#lines:
SELECT l.* FROM transcript_lines l JOIN segments s ON s.id = l.segmentId
        WHERE s.status = 'Done' AND l.voiceInputPendingUntil IS NULL AND EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM topic_spans ts WHERE ts.topicId = :id AND l.startAt >= ts.startAt AND l.startAt < ts.endAt)
        ORDER BY l.startAt, l.id
